name: com.unity.testframework.graphics
description: Unity's automated visual validation system for graphics rendering. Enables developers to catch visual regressions, validate rendering consistency across platforms and graphics APIs, and test custom Scriptable Render Pipelines through automated image comparison testing.

samples.description: Example graphics tests demonstrating scene-based testing and custom test scenarios
Demonstrates GraphicsTestParam and GraphicsTestParamSource for creating parameterized test variants with inline values and external data sources

Demonstrates ImageComparisonSettings configuration, HDR/EXR testing, ImageCapture utilities, multi-camera comparison, async image comparison, and custom texture comparison with SSIM/PSNR via IsTexture.EqualTo
Demonstrates IgnoreGraphicsTest, TestNotSupportedOn, and TestOnlySupportedOn attributes with various match modes and platform filters
Demonstrates EditorWindowCapture for capturing Editor windows and SceneViews, and ShaderTestFramework for unit-testing ShaderLab and HLSL shaders
Demonstrates custom test case sources, BakeLighting, custom pre-build setup, GlobalContext, custom IPlatformNode implementations, and the GraphicsTestLogger

_upm.changelog:
### Changed

- Updated `D3D12ValidationCommand` to use the renamed `UnityEngine.Rendering.GraphicsApiValidation` API (formerly `UnityEngine.D3D12Validation`).
